# The Material Symbols catalogue — every upstream icon name this crate ships,
# minus the tokens `icon_tokens.txt` already declares by hand.
#
# GENERATED FILE — DO NOT EDIT BY HAND.
# Produced by `tools/gen_icon_catalog.py` from
# `tools/material_symbols/upstream_codepoints.txt` (upstream's own codepoint list,
# vendored verbatim at the pinned revision). Regenerate with:
#     python3 tools/gen_icon_catalog.py
#
# # Format
#
#   <token> | <Variant> | <doc>
#
# The same three columns as `icon_tokens.txt`, so the two files concatenate into one
# declaration list. Order is upstream's codepoint order, which is stable across
# refreshes that do not add or remove a name — a refresh that does appears as a diff
# here, which is what a reviewer needs to see.
#
# The doc line states the upstream name and its codepoint: the codepoint is what
# upstream's variable font maps a ligature to, so it is the one fact that ties this
# line to a specific upstream entry.
#
